spec.description: Grafana dashboard for Blocky with PostgreSQL query logging

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  t.question_type,
  COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM
  log_entries t
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(t.request_ts)
  AND t.question_type in ($dns_types)
  AND t.client_name in ($client_names)
  AND t.response_type in ($response_types)
  AND (
    length('$question') = 0
    or POSITION(lower('$question') IN t.question_name) > 0
  )
GROUP BY
  t.question_type;

SELECT reason, COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM log_entries t
WHERE $__timeFilter(t.request_ts) AND 
  t.question_type in ($dns_types) AND
  t.question_name != '_dns.resolver.arpa' AND
 t.client_name in ($client_names) AND 
  t.response_type in ($response_types) AND 
  (length('$question') = 0 or POSITION(lower('$question') IN t.question_name) > 0)
GROUP BY reason
;

select 
  $__timeGroupAlias(t.request_ts, '$__interval'), 
  t.response_type, count(*) as cnt
from log_entries t
WHERE $__timeFilter(t.request_ts) AND 
  t.question_type in ($dns_types) AND
  t.client_name in ($client_names)
group by time, t.response_type 
order by time asc;

select 
  $__timeGroupAlias(t.request_ts, '$__interval'), 
  t.client_name, count(*) as cnt
from log_entries t
WHERE $__timeFilter(t.request_ts) AND 
  t.question_type in ($dns_types) AND
  t.client_name in ($client_names) AND 
  t.response_type in ($response_types) AND 
  (length('$question') = 0 or POSITION(lower('$question') IN t.question_name) > 0)
group by time, t.client_name 
order by cnt desc;

SELECT t.client_name, t.client_ip, COUNT(*) as cnt 
FROM log_entries t
WHERE $__timeFilter(t.request_ts) AND 
  t.question_type in ($dns_types) AND
  t.client_name in ($client_names) AND 
  t.response_type in ($response_types) AND 
  (length('$question') = 0 or POSITION(lower('$question') IN t.question_name) > 0)
GROUP BY t.client_name, t.client_ip
ORDER by cnt desc 
LIMIT 100;

select * FROM log_entries t
WHERE $__timeFilter(t.request_ts) AND 
  t.question_type in ($dns_types) AND
  t.client_name in ($client_names) AND 
  t.response_type in ($response_types) AND 
(length('$question') = 0 or POSITION(lower('$question') IN t.question_name) > 0)
ORDER BY request_ts desc limit 100;

SELECT t.client_name, t.client_ip, COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM log_entries t
where response_type='BLOCKED' AND
  $__timeFilter(t.request_ts) AND 
  t.question_type in ($dns_types) AND
  t.client_name in ($client_names) AND 
  t.response_type in ($response_types) AND 
  (length('$question') = 0 or POSITION(lower('$question') IN t.question_name) > 0)
GROUP BY t.client_name, t.client_ip 
ORDER by cnt desc 
LIMIT 100 ;

SELECT question_name, COUNT(*) FROM log_entries t
where response_type='BLOCKED' AND
  $__timeFilter(t.request_ts) AND 
  t.question_type in ($dns_types) AND
  t.client_name in ($client_names) AND 
  t.response_type in ($response_types) AND 
  (length('$question') = 0 or POSITION(lower('$question') IN t.question_name) > 0)
GROUP BY question_name ORDER by count desc LIMIT 100;

SELECT question_name, COUNT(*) FROM log_entries t
where response_type!='BLOCKED' AND
  $__timeFilter(t.request_ts) AND 
  t.question_type in ($dns_types) AND
  t.client_name in ($client_names) AND 
  t.response_type in ($response_types) AND 
  (length('$question') = 0 or POSITION(lower('$question') IN t.question_name) > 0) AND
  t.question_name NOT LIKE '%arpa' AND
  t.question_name NOT LIKE '%satan.network'
GROUP BY question_name ORDER by count desc LIMIT 100;
